info.name: Mini-grup_14 All API Endpoints
info.description:
Frontend-ready full Postman documentation for Mini-grup_14 API.

Recommended flow:
1. Run POST /api/auth/register/.
2. Copy the email verification code into {{verification_code}} if DEBUG did not auto-save it.
3. Run POST /api/auth/verify/.
4. Run POST /api/auth/token/ to save {{access_token}} and {{refresh_token}}.
5. Run GET /api/auth/me/ to save {{user_id}}.
6. Create Category, Brand, Product, Discount, Client, Order and related records in order.

Authentication:
- JWT endpoints use Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.
- Order endpoints require an authenticated verified user.

Variables:
- All created object IDs are saved into collection variables for the next requests.

variable.description: API base URL. Local default: http://127.0.0.1:8000.

Email verification or password reset code. In DEBUG mode register/resend saves it automatically.
JWT access token saved after POST /api/auth/token/.
JWT refresh token saved after POST /api/auth/token/.
User ID saved from GET /api/auth/me/ or Users create.
Seller ID saved from Sellers create.
SellerWallet ID saved from Wallets create.
Client profile ID saved from Clients create.
Cart item ID saved from Carts create.
Favorite ID saved from Favorites create.
Tag ID saved from Tags create.
LeadStatus ID saved from Lead Status create.
Brand ID saved from Brands create.
Category ID saved from Categories create.
Product ID saved from Products create.
Discount ID saved from Discounts create.
Order ID saved from Orders create.
OrderProduct ID saved from Order Products create.
Address ID saved from Addresses create.

header.description: Request body format. Use application/json for JSON payloads.

request.description:
### Purpose
Register a new account and send an email verification code.

### Endpoint
- Method: POST
- URL: {{base_url}}/api/auth/register/
- Auth required: No

### Request Fields
Body fields:
- email: unique email address; lower-cased by API. Username is generated automatically from the email.
- password: minimum 8 chars and validated by Django password validators.
- phone_number: required, must start with +.
- region: required user region.

### Response
Expected response: 201 Created for CRUD creates or 200 OK for auth actions.

### Postman Variables
Saved collection variables: {{verification_code}} when debug/reset code is present.

Partially update one record by ID. Send only changed fields.

### Endpoint
- Method: PATCH
- URL: {{base_url}}/products/discounts/{{discount_id}}/
- Auth required: No

### Request Fields
Body fields:
- name: discount name.
- product: product ID, optional in model but recommended for frontend use.
- discount_type: percentage or fixed_amount.
- value: decimal discount value. Percentage cannot be over 100.
- starts_at: optional ISO datetime or null.
- ends_at: optional ISO datetime or null; must be after starts_at.
- is_active: boolean.
Response includes product_name and final_price.

### Response
Expected response: 200 OK with updated record.

### Postman Variables
Saved collection variables: none.

request.description:
### Purpose
Return a list of records for this resource.

### Endpoint
- Method: GET
- URL: {{base_url}}/order/orders/
- Auth required: Yes, send Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.

### Request Fields
Body fields:
- payment_type: cash, card, cash_card or merchant.
- status: optional order status on update.
- is_active: boolean.
- products: optional array of nested order products with product, quantity and price.
- address: optional nested address object.
Server sets client from the authenticated user's client profile and calculates total_price from products.

### Response
Expected response: 200 OK with an array or paginated list of records.

### Postman Variables
Saved collection variables: none.
